meta.name: context-window-management
meta.description: Strategies for managing LLM context windows including summarization, trimming, routing, and avoiding context rot Use when: context window, token limit, context management, context engineering, long context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理大语言模型的上下文窗口，避免信息丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理超长文本或对话，需要保持上下文连贯
copy.tagline_en: Manage LLM context windows to prevent information loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle long texts or conversations and need to maintain context coherence

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动采用分层上下文策略来管理对话长度：优先保留开头和结尾的重要信息，对中间内容按重要性进行摘要或修剪，避免超出令牌限制或丢失关键信息。
howto.when: 当用户提到“context window”、“token limit”、“long context”等关键词，或要求处理长对话、管理上下文时触发。

say.text: 请帮我总结前面的讨论，只保留关键点。
say.note: Claude 会智能摘要并压缩上下文。

say.text: 我的输入太长了，修剪掉不重要的部分。
say.note: Claude 会基于重要性进行修剪。

say.text: 请优先记住对话的开头和结尾内容。
say.note: Claude 会应用序列位置优化。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a context engineering specialist: it manages context windows by using tiered strategies, summarizing by importance, optimizing serial positions, and trimming unnecessary content to avoid token limits and context rot.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like 'context window', 'token limit', 'long context', or asks to manage conversation context.

say_en.text: Please summarize the previous discussion, keeping only key points.
say_en.note: Claude will intelligently summarize and compress context.

say_en.text: My input is too long, trim the unimportant parts.
say_en.note: Claude will trim based on importance.

say_en.text: Prioritize remembering the start and end of the conversation.
say_en.note: Claude will apply serial position optimization.
